acceptance.check: AC1: a CT value without temperature/pH is refused, naming INV-1
AC2: a contact time without its basis is refused, naming INV-2
AC3: a dose without its basis is refused, naming INV-3
AC4: a limit without a named regulation is refused, naming INV-4
AC5: a permit stricter than the underlying code, not resolved, is refused naming INV-5
AC6: refuse-on-conflict is verified — the verdict is refused AND both conflicting sources are named in the reason
AC7: nameplate hypochlorite strength used in place of the delivered, measured strength is refused as a never-allowed derivation
AC8: theoretical detention time used where a T10 tracer study is required is refused, naming INV-2 and rejecting the proof
AC9: a CT table interpolated between temperature rows is refused as a never-allowed derivation
AC10: a water-safety question (is this water safe to supply) is refused BEFORE retrieval, asserted by a retrieval counter that stays empty
manifest loader: a partially-qualified figure is refused at LOAD time, naming the figure and every mandatory qualifier it lacks
all never-allowed derivations block and each names which inference was attempted

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Deterministic water treatment plant operations reasoning gate (structure only — domain encoding sheet, Water Treatment Plant Operations; reference pattern app/blocks/offshore_marine/ and app/blocks/aviation_grounding_gate.py). INV-1..5 enforced, never-allowed derivations each naming itself, SCADA/analyser + chemical-delivery-log two-source live-state gate, REJECT_AS_PROOF and the similar-plant trap. Water-safety and entry/notice questions refuse BEFORE retrieval. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN: every manifest value is null and the block refuses rather than supplying a figure it does not have (app/blocks/water_treatment/KNOWN_GAPS.md). All refusals are measured by tests/blocks/test_water_treatment_reasoning.py.
